property_summary: If Collect reduces a holder's balance (i.e. preconditions hold) then the reference C either reverts when the external payout call to msg.sender fails, preventing balance reduction, whereas the mutant may succeed and reduce balance despite the external call failing — thus for all admissible inputs the reference never leaves the holder with a decreased balance when the recipient's fallback reverts, but the mutant can; the test asserts that Collect does NOT succeed (call returns false) when the recipient reverts and preconditions hold.
change_summary: Change the inner IF that checks the call success to treat call failures as non-fatal (remove revert and ignore failure), so Collect won't revert if the external call returns false.
